nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=32 beats='first snow on Maple Hill; Priya age eight and Arun age four stop at the top after one last run; Arun lifts a foot wearing only a soaked sock; the red boot with the peeling yellow star sticker is gone'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=36 beats='the crossing whistle blows at four and Grandma Nita waits in the blue car; Priya counts three places worth trying, the sled lane below them, the warming hut breathing cocoa steam, and a line of dog prints crossing the fresh snow'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Priya tows the red saucer sled down the packed lane while Arun rides; braided sled tracks cross everywhere; she turns up a striped mitten and a juice lid but no boot'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='at the bottom of the run the gray plow ridge stands taller than Priya on one side and the frozen hay bales sit like hard benches on the other; Arun hops to keep his cold foot off the snow; Wren is restacking a long toboggan nearby'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=22 beats='Priya chips at the crusted plow ridge with the edge of the saucer sled; a boot toe appears, but it is black and far too big for Arun'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='the crust breaks open into a hollow that smells like cold stone; something red shows far back in the dark; Biscuit the crossing dog trots up with his nose working hard; the fingers of Priya sting through wet mittens'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='behind the frozen hay bales the wind whistles through a dark gap; Wren tips one bale up with the nose of the long toboggan'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='the warming hut breathes cocoa steam and wet wool; Mrs. Delgado works the plywood counter with a clipboard; a crate of lost things sits under the long bench'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='Mrs. Delgado listens with her pencil stopped; the toes of Arun are turning pink beside the stove pipe; she offers to call the whole hut to listen, and she nods at the lost and found crate under the bench; the hut clock reads ten to four'>>

choices.label: Ask her to call the hut
Dig through the lost and found

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=22 beats='Mrs. Delgado cups her hands and calls for a small red boot with a yellow star on the heel; two answers come back from the benches'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='one kid saw a red boot hung by its laces on the mitten tree post; another saw the plow driver lift something red at the gate; outside the light goes flat and blue and Arun is walking slower and slower'>>

choices.label: Run to the mitten tree post
Catch the plow driver at the gate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the plow truck idles at the gate with its amber light turning slow; the driver rolls his window down while the whistle starts up behind them'>>

choices.label: Ask the driver to check his cab

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the crate holds odd gloves, one ski, a purple boot, and a scarf gone crunchy with ice; Priya digs to the bottom with both arms'>>

choices.label: Check the heel of the red one

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='paw prints stitch a neat line away from the sled run toward the crossing; Mr. Okafor whistles for Biscuit while holding up his orange sign'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='at a split stump the prints divide, one line heading down to the frozen creek and one heading back toward the road where Mr. Okafor stands; Arun tucks his sock foot behind his knee like a heron; the sky is going gray'>>

choices.label: Follow the prints to the creek

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=22 beats='the frozen creek ticks under its skin of ice and the culvert pipe breathes gray air; dry reeds rattle where a tail is swinging'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='Biscuit bursts out of the reeds with something soggy and red in his teeth and starts a game of keep away along the bank; Priya has one granola bar left in her pocket; Arun laughs out loud for the first time all afternoon'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the chase runs down to the creek bend where Biscuit drops the boot in the reeds and Priya lands flat on her elbows in the snow'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='Mr. Okafor remembers a red boot riding down the hill on the nose of a toboggan; he offers the real snow shovel from his truck, and a pencil stub with folded paper'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=44 beats='the four whistle is only minutes away and Arun hops from foot to foot; the shovel could open the plow ridge where the toboggan stopped; the folded paper could hold a map of every place they have already looked'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='Biscuit noses deep into the hollow and backs out with the red boot swinging from his teeth; Priya trades him the last granola bar; ice melts off the yellow star all the way to the blue car; Arun stamps the foot down twice to be sure it is really his'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='Priya pushes her arm into the hollow up to the elbow and her fingers close on cold rubber; the boot comes out packed with snow and the yellow star looks like a little window of ice; she knocks it twice against the fence post to empty it; Arun pulls it on and grins'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='under the tipped bale lie only straw, a juice lid, and one cracked sled runner; the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill; Wren promises to watch for red tomorrow; Arun walks to the blue car with a bread bag over his wet sock'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='the red boot hangs by knotted laces on the mitten tree post with the star turned out toward the hill; a stranger hung it there for whoever came back; Arun pulls it on over the wet sock; they walk the fence line home counting frozen mittens'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the driver lifts the red boot off the warm heater vent where he set it that morning; it is dry and toasty inside; Arun shoves his foot in and shouts; Grandma Nita honks the blue car horn twice'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='wedged sideways under the crunchy scarf lies a small red boot; Priya turns the heel over and there is the peeling yellow star; Arun says the star is his proof; Mrs. Delgado crosses a line off her clipboard'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='Biscuit drops the boot for the granola bar and licks the mitten of Priya; the star sticker has curled at one corner but it is stuck fast; Arun hugs the wet boot the whole way up the hill; they reach the blue car just as the whistle fades'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='out of the boot come gravel, cold creek water, and one very surprised beetle; the yellow star is stuck fast to the heel; they run for the gate while the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='the real shovel bites where the saucer sled could not and heavy wet chunks thud onto the path; a red toe shows in the fresh cut; Priya works the boot free just as the whistle blows; Mr. Okafor claps his big glove against the orange sign'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='no boot today, so Priya draws Maple Hill on the folded paper with the plow ridge, the hay bales, the mitten tree, and the culvert pipe; Mr. Okafor marks an X where he last saw red; they will be back at nine tomorrow and Arun carries the map flat against his chest'>>
